segments.contextBefore: Filter a multichannel signal with a cascade of biquadratic sections.
segments.contextAfter: The vDSP library implements biquadratic filtering as a cascade of individual infinite impulse response (IIR) filters called *sections.* Each section has its own set of feedback and feedforward coefficients, and implements a direct-form 2 filter.
